rules: Author one purpose-built campaign terrain; do not stitch donor showcase levels together literally.
Use donor landscapes for height/material/landform vocabulary and source data, not for arbitrary world borders.
Settlement silhouettes must correspond to the actual visitable settlement donor used by that faction.
Roads, rivers, passes and forest belts are gameplay communication first and decoration second.
Use RB Weather for weather presentation and RB Optimization for repeated/static representation before bespoke systems.
Overmap geography must preserve the same biome/landform/feature promise used to select tactical battlefield recipes.

crownspine.identity: continuous mountain spine, quarry terraces, engineered passes

heartland.identity: temperate roads, farms/grassland, river approaches, fortified capital

eastern_badlands.identity: mesa shelves, gullies, occupied ruins, broad War Elephant lanes

greenwood.identity: deep forest, river woodland, meadow edges, shrine terraces

ashen_south.identity: ash plain, corrupted valley, broken causeways, oppressive fortress horizon

surface_bindings.ue_gate: Purpose-built terrain + settlement proxies only after the active realtime-battle lane releases UE.
